assets.title: 门外的孩子
assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE NEW 16:9 photoreal CINEMATIC OPENING FRAME for a quiet silent narrative film, not a poster, storyboard, collage or character display. Input image 1 supplies the exact preteen Hamilton identity, neck-length loose dark hair, worn off-white shirt, dark brown waistcoat, brown breeches, the wooden room, clearly empty bed, gray cloth and brown ceramic bowl. Keep the same child, same clothes and objects. RECOMPOSE the shot substantially: static camera set farther back in the adjoining room, eye height about 1.25m, natural 40mm perspective. A dark plain doorway stile occupies about the leftmost 15 percent of the frame; a little out-of-focus door edge at far right. Through the opening, the child is modest in scale, seated at approximately 43 percent across the frame, full small body visible, on a plain stool beside the EMPTY bed on the right. The distance and unused floor between child and bed must be readable. The child looks down at the small damp gray cloth still held loosely in BOTH hands above his knees, without squeezing it or performing sadness. The brown water bowl is on the floor within easy reach. The bed is unambiguously flat and unoccupied with plain pillow and loose linen at its far end; no person or human contour hidden anywhere in bedding. A simple side window provides quiet overcast daylight onto the child's hands and part of the empty bedding; keep the face gently readable in soft half-shadow, not a silhouette. Let ordinary room space and time dominate rather than face beauty. Restrained palette of cool chalk-gray plaster, off-white linen and brown timber with real selective wear; do not add decorative grime or mold patterns. The image should feel like a thoughtful observer has stopped at the door before anything happens. No tears, upward gazes, theatrical poses, heavy film-grain overlay, glamour, golden shafts, lens flare, strong vignette, elaborate props, readable text, titles, captions, logos, watermark or borders. Absolutely one complete continuous scene, no frame divisions.

assets.title: 笔还没有落下
assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE NEW 16:9 photoreal CINEMATIC OPENING FRAME for a silent film about memory and writing. Input image 1 is the approved exact teenage Hamilton, same clean-shaven face, low dark ponytail, olive skin, linen shirt, waistcoat, damaged plank shutter, desk, quill, inkpot and blank paper. Preserve their identity and appearance. Reframe CLOSER from the SAME LEFT-shoulder-rear side: fixed slightly elevated 55mm natural perspective. The off-white blank paper and the two forearms become the compositional center in the lower half of the frame, with the right-hand quill nib visibly hovering about a centimeter above the blank paper at the frame's center. The LEFT hand rests on bare tabletop just beside the near-left paper edge, not pressing it yet. His shoulder, a small recognizable side portion of his young face and ear stay at the far RIGHT of the frame; do not turn it into a full-face portrait. The clearly damaged shutter and its narrow gray daylight opening remain in the upper LEFT background, along with a modest area of water-stained plaster, so the room after a storm is still understandable. Keep moderate depth of field: the nib and hands clear, shutter structure identifiable, not melted bokeh. Squat dark ceramic inkpot left of the page, ordinary trimmed goose quill, realistic finger joints and normal grip. One and only one RIGHT hand holds the pen; one and only one LEFT hand rests beside paper. Soft quiet cool-neutral daylight, honest linen and wood, moderate contrast, slightly uneven natural exposure, not a polished luxury writing advertisement. There are NO marks yet on the page. The intended moment is the hesitation BEFORE a first short sentence, no writing action already finished. No dramatic beam, glowing paper, elegant calligraphy, excessively huge feather, extreme macro skin, heroic expression, floating ink, grunge overlay, readable text, letters, captions, watermark, borders, split frames or camera blur. One believable physical frame with a deliberate point of attention.

assets.title: 灯下的一张桌子
assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE NEW 16:9 photoreal cinematic opening frame filmed in a real small black-box theatre. Input image 1 defines the EXACT stage floorboards, modest dark square-legged wood table, simple chair, black side boundaries and practical material style. Input image 2 defines the EXACT CHILD Hamilton identity and child's body proportions, loose neck-length dark hair, off-white linen shirt, dark brown waistcoat, brown breeches, cream stockings and worn shoes. Use only ONE child from that identity board. This is the BEGINNING of the story, not the departure in image 1: remove the adolescent, travel bag, letter, boarding ramp and rail entirely. Keep the table center-left and the stage's plain timber floor. Place a simple narrow wooden EMPTY bed behind the table toward the left, with an obviously flat mattress, ordinary pale pillow and a loosely folded small linen sheet; absolutely no person or human form on or under the bed linen. Child sits on a modest stool BETWEEN bed and table, visible without obstruction, holding a plain brown ceramic water bowl naturally in both hands just above his lap. A small damp gray cloth lies near a faint circular water mark on the table. He looks down toward bowl and table as though deciding where to put it, quiet ordinary concentration, closed mouth, no performance to an audience. A fixed eye-level 35mm medium-wide camera slightly to the left shows the whole simple arrangement and enough dark unused stage at the right to establish theatre space. The child is present but not oversized; the empty bed, table and actual black wing boundaries remain readable. Light is a broad soft neutral SIDE wash falling naturally across wooden floor and tabletop, tapering gradually into dim space, NOT a circular spotlight or shining cone. Real rough timber and linen, quiet practical stage photography, selective genuine wear. No audience, stage crew, modern rigging, red velvet curtains, projected clouds, fog, gold rim light, symmetry for display, dollhouse look, CGI architecture, frozen dance poses, tears, captions, logos, text, watermarks or borders. One complete stage image, no multiple views. It should feel like sitting quietly in a small theatre before the child places the bowl down.
